checkpoints: Navigate once to the isolated original menu; inspect screenshot and errors
One ordinary visible Play or tutorial-start button
One bounded real mouse hold/release for the visible bridge gap
One further ordinary bridge hold/release or native next button, selected from actual preceding screen
Reload to inspect original local progression if gameplay is proved; otherwise one remaining ordinary input within budget
input_rules: One player action per checkpoint. A mouse hold is one move/down/declared duration/up sequence, logged fully. No hidden target-distance reads, RNG/time changes, business callbacks or stored-value writes.
observations: Screenshots, actual local requests/responses/errors, visible labels and read-only current score/bridge count. No assertions of full game, all characters or all random layouts.
stop_rule: Preserve any failure and count it. Never exceed five cumulative checkpoints or reset the limit. Close the actual owned browser after pass/defer.
